text: Your nine percent hike? It's really five.
Say you earn ten lakh. A nine point one percent hike? That's ninety-one thousand rupees. On paper.
Then inflation shows up. Rent. Groceries. Fuel. School fees. Each one takes a bite. That ninety-one thousand? In real buying power, about fifty-one thousand. Real wage growth: five point one percent.
You can't stop inflation. But you CAN control what you carry into your appraisal.
One. Bring a number, not effort. "I worked really hard" isn't a KPI. [YOUR METRIC] is.
Two. Name who benefited. Which team, which client, which leader got the win? Say it.
Three. Ask early. Get the conversation on the calendar before ratings lock. Not after.
Inflation takes its cut. Your proof decides the rest. Comment your hike percent. I'll reply with your real number.
